source.title: Continental Championship 2022 Announcement (November 2020)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that Cape Town will be hosting the upcoming WCA African Continental Championship in 2022.

An additional thank you to the applicants from Cairo, Egypt for their submission for the African Continental Championship 2022. You can view the application documents for the Continental Championships [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vxgEF_hNNIq9ukDLdL1OLyS3pKpL_-eg).  

The decision to host the WCA South American Championship 2022 has been deferred.

Lastly, a reminder that the WCA Oceania Championship 2022 will have an application period from March 1st to May 31st, 2021 in line with the World Championship 2023 application period.

translation.title: 2022 年洲际锦标赛举办地公告（2020 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，开普敦将举办 2022 年 WCA 非洲锦标赛。

同时感谢埃及开罗的团队提交 2022 年非洲锦标赛申办方案。洲际锦标赛的申办材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vxgEF_hNNIq9ukDLdL1OLyS3pKpL_-eg)查看。

2022 年 WCA 南美锦标赛举办地的决定已推迟。

最后提醒大家，2022 年 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛的申办期为 2021 年 3 月 1 日至 5 月 31 日，与 2023 年世界锦标赛申办期一致。
